name: Cheesy Baked Penne with Tomato, Spinach & Roasted Red Peppers

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, medium dice peppers and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
1 ½ (454 g) bags frozen chopped spinach

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain in the colander over the spinach; return pasta and spinach to the pot.
Add diced peppers, marinara sauce, and ricotta to the pot with the pasta and spinach; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (680 g) jars marinara sauce
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place pasta over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until just warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Divide pasta between two baking dishes and top with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide pasta bake between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
